department: Graduate School of Medical and Health Sciences (GSMHS)

deadline.value: The GSMHS join-us page gives no deadline; admission follows the university's central application.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Find a PhD supervisor first; joining the graduate school is possible once you are registered at the University.
supervisor.quote: Your first step is to find a PhD supervisor who guides you during the PhD project and studies

funding.value: The graduate school does not offer funded positions; many students rely on third-party project funding or their own fellowships.

entry_route.value: Admission needs a master's degree that qualifies for the chosen subject; other degrees are judged for equivalence by the interfaculty board.
entry_route.quote: Candidates seeking admission to this doctorate must hold a master’s degree from a Swiss university or a Swiss Federal Institute of Technology that qualifies for the chosen doctoral subject

also.quote: Other degrees from a higher education institution recognized by the University of Basel may be classified as entirely, partially or not equivalent by the interfaculty doctoral board

notes: One interfaculty graduate school (Faculties of Medicine and Science) covering Medicines Development, Infection Biology and Biomedical Engineering. Application uses the central university process, so the university fee applies. The interfaculty entry rule quoted here names Swiss degrees first and is not the central rule.
name: Graduate School of Medical and Health Sciences
